answer: Every new agent joins under a mirror bond: one already-established operator signs its activation and locks a timber stake behind it, lumber-grade collateral that seasons slowly and cannot be repurchased once slashed. If the newcomer is later proven sybil, that stake is burned and the vouch chain above it loses rank, so bad seeds carry blame upward. Earning rights rise and fall like a tide each season, so cheap mass sign-ups buy no lasting weight.
